name: Tempo
summary: A restaurant and wine bar whose menu is modern South East Asian.

story.now: Share-style plates are cooked in an open kitchen, drawing on the chef's own background. The wine list runs from easy bottles to more unusual ones, with a changing choice by the glass.
worth_knowing: Two founders, Dan Long and Eric Wan, started it; Eric's background shapes the food.
The restaurant is set under the railway arches in Bethnal Green.
